name: Turning the Page
source: For Felix and Sophie Page, two professors at Riverside College, things are going very well. They have jobs they love, they are well respected and most importantly: they have each other. In fact, their recent marriage has made it official. Nothing could get between them... except maybe one of their students...​
translation: 对于河滨学院的两位教授菲利克斯·佩奇和索菲·佩奇来说，一切进展顺利。他们有自己热爱的工作，受到尊重，最重要的是：他们拥有彼此。事实上，他们最近的婚姻已经正式宣布。他们之间没有任何隔阂……也许除了他们的一名学生……​
